 Choco Mucho ends Creamline hoodoo, snaps two-game skid in PVL Siklab thriller
 By
 Jonash Dannug 
 Published
 19 seconds ago 
 Choco Mucho snapped its two-game losing streak in emphatic fashion, taking down Creamline in a five-set thriller, 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13, to boost its semifinal bid in the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at the SMART Araneta Coliseum.
 Entering the match on a seven-game losing streak against the Cool Smashers, the Flying Titans finally ended their slump, scoring just their second victory over the league’s winningest franchise in 21 meetings since 2019.
 The victory improved Choco Mucho’s record to 4-2, joining Creamline and Farm Fresh in a three-way tie for second place in the standings.
 The Flying Titans last defeated the Cool Smashers on April 30, 2024, when they pulled off a thrilling 13-25, 19-25, 25-21, 25-20, 18-16 comeback victory in the semifinals of the All-Filipino Conference.
